name: GameState
description: The shared state of a running game that every player can observe, such as scores and the roster. A level selects its game state in World Settings.

methods.name: on_init
methods.doc: Called once when the game state is created, before play begins.

methods.name: on_player_added
methods.doc: Called when a player joins the roster.

methods.name: on_player_removed
methods.doc: Called when a player leaves the roster.
